scope: R13-R15 machine-readable extensions to existing WPA Human Gate, HGAIM and scholarly knowledge governance

continuity.existing_r11_r12_framework: WPA AI Authority, Rights & Remedies Framework v1.3 remains valid

extensions.name: Agentic Boundary Security
extensions.human_gate_effect: Unexpected boundary crossing escalates to at least HG2; critical-consequence domains to HG3; new authority to HG4.

extensions.name: Knowledge Acquisition & Rights Gate
extensions.human_gate_effect: Rights uncertainty defaults to metadata/discovery only; persistent full text requires a lawful rights basis and applicable Human Gate.

extensions.name: Synthetic Identity & Digital Continuity
extensions.human_gate_effect: Public/institutional synthetic representation is HG2; biometric/neural/legal identity effect is HG3; new authority or office claim is HG4.

extensions.name: Embodied Public-Space Safety, De-escalation & Social Licence
extensions.human_gate_effect: Public consequence/recording is HG2; security/policing/health/identity-sensitive embodied role is HG3; new public authority claim is HG4.

cross_cutting_invariants: Authority may be narrowed automatically within mandate but never expanded automatically.
A discovered vulnerability or technical path is not permission.
Successful task completion never cures an unauthorised method.
Discovery is not permission; access is not a licence.
A synthetic persona does not inherit the office or authority of its human referent.
Provocation is not permission for machine retaliation.
Physical presence is not public authority.
Every consequential event preserves provenance, mandate, control mode, responsible human owner, pause path and remedy path.
doctrine: Human Constitutional Primacy and Protocol Realism remain unchanged: machine capability, persistence, embodiment, resemblance or technical reach do not create final institutional legitimacy, mandate or responsibility.
